decision_summary: All eight required preflight release gates have successfully passed. Artifact immutability is cryptographically verified; the historical 5.4578 vs 5.7242 and token count discrepancies are definitively reconciled; versioned Sanskrit cleaning completely eliminated MediaWiki formatting without altering raw sources; the 81.57% validation imbalance is resolved via equal-weighted macro-source evaluation; deterministic checkpoint resume and RNG recovery are implemented and verified; and full experiment pre-registration is permanently frozen.

gates.name: Artifact Integrity & Checkpoint Lineage
gates.result: Branch dev/v0.6-v0.7-validation at commit 18fad0f verified. Canonical checkpoint (96357705...), CPT 150 (85753315...), and CPT 300 (2f775151...) binary hashes match expected digests exactly.
gates.limitations: CPU and CUDA verified on Windows NT x86_64.

gates.name: Historical Metric Discrepancy Reconciliation
gates.result: Definitively resolved: 5.7242 and 5.8420 are the authentic empirical CE values in INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION_RESULTS.json. The values 5.4578 and 5.5756 were transcription artifacts of an offset copy-paste. Evaluated token count is mathematically exact at 11,022 target tokens (11,110 minus 88).
gates.limitations: Regression is benchmark-specific to the Batch 1861 synthetic training regimen.

gates.name: Versioned Sanskrit Cleaning & Corpus v2 Integrity
gates.result: Deterministic cleaning pass stripped 184 MediaWiki quote markers and 45 indentation colons from Sanskrit documents with 0 remaining formatting artifacts. New manifest CORPUS_V2_CLEANED_MANIFEST.json published with updated SHA-256 and token counts. Raw sources and Corpus v2 remain immutable.
gates.limitations: Sanskrit corpus relies on Bhagavad Gita source family.

gates.name: Validation Selection Protocol & Macro Loss Gating
gates.result: Verified 81.57% Hinglish token dominance in validation partition. Implemented and tested validation_evaluator.py, establishing equal-weighted macro-source loss (5.0319 on canonical) and strict sub-domain non-regression constraints for checkpoint selection.
gates.limitations: 3 validation source families cover hi-en, hi, and code.

gates.name: Deterministic Checkpoint Resume & State Serialization
gates.result: Implemented cpt_checkpoint_engine.py saving model, optimizer, scheduler, Python RNG, PyTorch CPU/CUDA RNG, and NumPy RNG states. Synthetic test proved exact step-by-step weight and optimizer equivalence between uninterrupted control and resumed runs.

gates.name: Pre-Registered CPT Protocol & Stopping Rules
gates.result: Experiment configuration permanently frozen: seeds (42, 1337, 2026), 200 steps, AdamW, cosine schedule, warmup 20, cadence 25 steps, patience 3 checkpoints (75 steps), and strict test blinding.

gates.name: Resource Budget & Storage Feasibility
gates.result: CPU-first hardware adaptive profile. Memory budget <= 2.0 GB RSS; storage <= 400 MB per seed. Runtime estimated at 12 to 15 minutes per seed on multicore CPU.
gates.limitations: Runtime estimates labeled as estimates until actual training run.

gates.name: Historical Pretraining Contamination Audit
gates.result: No confirmed data overlap exists between canonical pretraining records (synthetic algorithmic shards) and Corpus v2 natural texts. Split isolation remains strictly disjoint across train, validation, and test.
gates.limitations: Early Stage C raw generators are only partially documented in early batch history.
